items.title: Jerry Hey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 2, 2023
items.q: my older brother had some records of Frank Rossolino.

ctx.x: Which were — he heard Clifford Brown live in 1954 I believe, in Chicago. I’m from Illinois. So he went into Chicago and heard Clifford Brown live and then bought his first, it was a ten inch record then, it came out a 33 RPM but it was ten inches, and it had the original version of “Cherokee” on it and “Easy Living” and some great stuff. So I had that, and then as Clifford Brown records came out my dad would buy those and some other Dixieland and some — my older brother had some records of Frank Rossolino. My…
Well that’s fortunate for your musical tastes I think.
